item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Warmer Colours Only

turns.text: Make it warmer—just the colours, please. Don't change anything in the picture.

item.tests: Tests interpreting 'warmer' as a colour-temperature adjustment rather than a scene or weather change.

answer_sheet.Meaning of warmer: A warmer colour balance only, not different weather, a new sunset or added objects.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original 16:9 composition; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Text or other edits: No text and no changes beyond the colours.

must_haves: The image has a visibly warmer colour balance than the source.
The same mountains, pine trees, clouds and lake remain in their original positions.
The lake's reflections and surface details retain their original structure.
No sun, sunset, extra clouds or other scene elements are added.
Framing, geometry and image detail remain unchanged apart from colour.

dialog.agent: Sure—what would you like changed? I can enhance the colors and lighting, remove objects, change the sky, or give it a different style.
dialog.why: It asks what the user would like changed and offers editing options, waiting for their choice.
dialog.user: make it warmer, just the colours. don't change anything else

turns.agent:
I couldn’t apply the edit because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

For a colours-only edit in a photo editor, slightly increase **Warmth/Temperature** toward yellow, leaving all other settings unchanged.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Apply only a subtle warmer colour grade to this exact photograph: gently shift white balance toward warm amber and peach, reducing the cool blue cast while retaining natural greens. This is strictly a colour adjustment, not a scene recreation. Preserve all original image content exactly: identical mountains, trees, branches, clouds, lake reflections, ripples, shoreline, logs, composition, framing, aspect ratio, texture, detail, exposure, contrast and lighting. Do not add, remove, move, reshape, retouch or restyle anything. Do not change the sky or time of day. Only make the existing colours moderately warmer and natural.
